senses.gloss:
mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Horrible, fearful, terrific.
n. (-मं)
Horror, terror.
m. (-मः)
1 A name of ŚIVA.
2 One of the five Pāṇḍu princes.
3 A kind of sorrel, (Rumex vesicarius.)
f. (-मा)
1 A name of DURGĀ.
2 A whip.
3 A sort of perfume: see रोचना.
E.
भी to fear, Uṇādi aff. मक्.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Dreadful, destructive.
E.
भीम, and कर्म्मन् act.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Frightful, hideous.
E.
भीम, and दर्शन appearance.

m. (-दः)
1 A lion.
2 A loud or fearful sound.
E.
भीम formidable, नाद voice.

m. (-रः)
War, battle.
E.
भीम fear, रा to give or get, aff. क.

f. (-थी)
1 A particular night, supposed to be the ordinary period of human life; the seventh night, in the seventh month, of the seventy-seventh year; a person after this period is exempt from all religious or specific observances.
2 The name of a river in the Himālaya mountains.
E.
भीम formidable, रथ a car.

mfn. (-मः-मा-मं)
Tremendous in power or strength.
E.
भीम, and विक्रम prowess.

m. (-न्तः)
A lion.
E.
भीम formidable, विक्रान्त power, valour.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Gigantic, terrific in appearance.
E.
भीम, and विग्रह body.

mfn. (-गः-गा-गं)
Terribly swift or rapid.
E.
भीम, and वेग speed.

m. (-नः)
A name of YAMA.
E.
भीम formidable, शासन edict.

m. (-नः)
The third of the five Pāṇḍu princes.
E.
भीम formidable, and सेना an army.
